workflows.name: collage
workflows.description: Make motion graphics in a cut-paper collage style, with photos, paper and print cut out and put together by hand. Use for explainers, promos, stories, intros and social posts, or when the person asks for a collage, cut-paper, scrapbook, zine or mixed-media look (剪贴风, 拼贴, 手账风, 杂志拼贴).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: keynote
workflows.description: Make a product film in the style of a big tech launch keynote: the real product on stage, one confident claim at a time. Use for app, website, software and gadget launches, feature announcements and product intros, or when the person asks for a keynote, launch event, premium or minimal tech style (发布会, 产品发布, 新品, 高级感).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: long-to-short
workflows.description: Turn a long video (a talk, podcast, interview, lesson, livestream or vlog) into short vertical clips that each stand alone and hold attention from the first second. Use when the person gives a long recording and asks for clips, shorts, highlights or cut-downs for Douyin, Reels, Shorts or similar (长视频转短视频, 切片, 剪短视频, 高光, 拆条).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: lyric-video
workflows.description: Make a lyric video for a song that the artist would release as the official one — a piece made for this one song, every word landing exactly on the voice. Use when the person gives a song (with its lyrics or an .lrc file) and asks for a lyric video, a music video with words, karaoke-style lyrics or a song post (歌词视频, 动态歌词, 歌词 MV, 卡拉OK).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: motion-graphics
workflows.description: Make premium motion graphics (an explainer, a promo, a title sequence or a data story) designed and animated at the level of a top studio, for this subject alone. Use when the person asks for motion graphics, an MG animation, an animated explainer, a promo or an intro that should look high end (高级 MG, 动效, 动画视频, 片头, 宣传动画).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: presenter-pip
workflows.description: Make a talking-head video where the content fills the screen and the presenter speaks from a small window: slides, screens, charts and pictures that follow what they say, their face always there. Use when the person gives a recording of themselves talking (with slides, a screen, data or notes) and asks for a lesson, a knowledge video, a business review, a commentary or a presentation with them in a corner (小窗人物口播, 画中画, 口播, 讲解视频).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: replicate
workflows.description: Remake a reference video in OpenFilm, as close as the person wants it, from frame for frame to its structure, rhythm, look and motion carrying their own content. Use when the person gives a video, as a file or a link, and asks for an exact copy of it, one like it, its style or pacing, or a remake for their product or topic (复刻, 照着做, 做个同款, 一模一样, 仿这个视频).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: screen-demo
workflows.description: Turn a screen recording into a polished product demo or tutorial: the view follows the action, dead time is gone, every step is easy to see, and the product looks as good as it is. Use when the person gives a screen recording (or a product to capture) and asks for a demo, walkthrough, tutorial, feature video or how-to (录屏演示, 产品演示, 教程, 操作视频, 功能介绍).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: vintage-film
workflows.description: Make the person's photos and clips into a memory film that looks shot on old film or kept as instant photos and prints. Use for memories and recaps (a trip, a birthday, a graduation, a wedding, a year, a child growing up) or when the person asks for a retro, film, analog, Polaroid or instant-photo look (复古, 胶片, 拍立得, 回忆, 相册, 年度回顾).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed

workflows.name: whiteboard
workflows.description: Make an explainer drawn on a board while a voice explains, every drawing and word drawn out as it is spoken. Use for lessons, micro-lectures, training, how-it-works and concept explainers, when the person turns a document, slides or notes into an explainer, or asks for a whiteboard, hand-drawn, sketch or doodle style (白板, 手绘, 讲解, 微课, 课件).
workflows.source_kind: creative workflow instructions; no implementation executed
